title: 3.0 beta3 - homescreen doesn't update right
body:
Weird issue with the homescreen. 

BG data is coming in. Calculations are being made, as is visible on the message / announcements screen, but on the aaps homescreen the data isn't updating, and time looks like running back. (amount of minutes of last bg reading is going up faster than the actual time). 

See screenshot and the timestamp of the screenshots.

Restarting aaps and clearing cache doesn't help. 

After 10 more minutes the issue disappeared. (last screenshot).
